id.description: Identifies this sequence for playback by a "sequence" event.

url.description: Canonical location of this sequence. May be an at:// URI or an https:// URL to a JSON endpoint.

tags.description: Array of strings used to tag the sequence.

items.description:
An event of the form `[beat, type, ...params]` where `beat` is a 64-bit float and `type` is a string. 

Beat values are arbitrary, and depend on the rate of playback of a sequence. A sequence playing back at a rate of 1 runs at 1 beat per second, and is following absolute time. 

Known specified types are "chord", "clef", "key", "meter", "note", "param", "rate", "sequence", "start", "stop" and "text". Additional parameters depend on `type`. Types are not limited to those specified and consumers are expected to ignore event types they do not support.

sequences.description: A collection of sequences that may be played back by "sequence" events.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the time of last edit.

bskyPostRef.description: Strong reference to a Bluesky post. Useful to keep track of comments off-platform.

publishedAt.description: Timestamp of the time of publication.

main.description: A sequence of timed events. Full documentation at https://github.com/soundio/sequence/.
